-- ============================================================================
-- Idempotent External Delta Table Setup for Azure Synapse Serverless SQL
-- ============================================================================

-- 0. Switch to your user database (uncomment and replace with your DB name)
-- USE [SalesAnalyticsDB];
-- GO

-- ============================================================================
-- STEP 1: Clean up existing objects in reverse dependency order
-- ============================================================================
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.DimCustomer', 'U') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.DimCustomer;
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'DeltaFormat')
    DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [DeltaFormat];
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'SilverDataLake')
    DROP EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [SilverDataLake];
GO

IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.database_scoped_credentials WHERE name = 'SynapseManagedIdentity')
    DROP DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL [SynapseManagedIdentity];
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- STEP 2: Create Master Key (only if one does not already exist in this DB)
-- ============================================================================
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.symmetric_keys WHERE name = '##MS_DatabaseMasterKey##')
BEGIN
    CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'YourStrongPassword123!';
END
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- STEP 3: Create Credential, Data Source, File Format & External Table
-- ============================================================================
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL [SynapseManagedIdentity]
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [SilverDataLake]
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://azuresynapsevcc@azuresynapsevcc.dfs.core.windows.net/vccfamily/vcc-root',
    CREDENTIAL = [SynapseManagedIdentity]
);
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [DeltaFormat]
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELTA
);
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.DimCustomer (
    CustomerID INT,
    FullName NVARCHAR(100),
    Province NVARCHAR(50),
    UpdatedAt DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '/customers/',
    DATA_SOURCE = [SilverDataLake],
    FILE_FORMAT = [DeltaFormat]
);
GO

-- ============================================================================
-- STEP 4: Verify the External Delta Table
-- ============================================================================
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dbo.DimCustomer;
GO
